title: Minimalist Album Cover with Time Notation
coreRelationships: Large numerical text dominates the lower half of the composition.
Small descriptive text is centered at the top, providing context.
A horizontal line underlines the descriptive text, creating a subtle graphic element.
The stark contrast between the black text and the light peach background is central to the visual impact.
reuseFormula: Create a solid light peach background. Place large, bold, black sans-serif numbers '4:44' at the bottom center. Place smaller, black, serif text 'THIS IS HIS 13TH STUDIO ALBUM' at the top center, with a thin black underline directly beneath it.
